messages.content: 尋找Netflix上《六人行》的電視節目列表及其評分，以及Hulu上《我們的辦公室》和《怪奇物語》的評分，並按照評分排序。

function.name: streaming_services_shows_list_and_ratings
function.description: Get a list of shows and their ratings on specific streaming services. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

show_list.description: List of show names to search for on the platform.

sort_by_rating.description: If set to true, returns the list sorted by ratings. Defaults to false.

- For Hulu: "Our Office" (likely "The Office") and "Stranger Things". They want ratings for those two shows on Hulu, sorted by rating.

We need to call the function streaming_services_shows_list_and_ratings twice: once for Netflix with show_list ["Six Feet Under"], sort_by_rating maybe not needed because only one show. Then for Hulu with show_list ["The Office", "Stranger Things"], sort_by_rating true.

But the user wrote "我們的辦公室" which translates to "Our Office" but likely refers to "The Office". We should interpret it as "The Office".

Also "怪奇物語" is "Stranger Things".
